 Early Voting for Ouachita Parish will be November 28th through December 5th at 8:30 a.m. until 6:00 p.m. Early voting will be closed on Sundays. 
 Early Voting Locations are Registrar of Voters, 701 St John Street, Monroe Louisiana and West Ouachita Senior Center, 1800 North 7th Street, West Monroe Louisiana. 
 Saturday, November 21st is the deadline to register for online voting.
 To register to vote online visit www.geauxvote.com
